headline_plain: Skip it for now: the first goal pays only about $1.30 for every $1 you could lose, Ether is still sliding, and very few people are trading right now.
explain_plain: The idea was to buy Ether, a digital coin, after it fell fast, hoping for a quick bounce later today. Bull said it fell so far so fast that it should spring back a little, like a stretched rubber band. Bear said it is still going down on every chart and almost nobody is buying, so the bounce could fail. Most of the numbers both sides used were correct. Bull's final plan was careful, but the first goal only wins about $28 for a possible $21 loss, and our rule needs at least $1.50 won for each $1 risked. Also, the big drop happened at the exact minute a US price report came out, so it may not be the 'everyone gave up' moment Bull thinks it was. That is why we skip.
plan_plain: The trade would have been: buy Ether at about $2,068, sell to stop the loss if it falls to $2,047 (a $21 loss per coin), and sell for profit at $2,096 and then $2,113 later today.
retake_plain: This would be worth a fresh look if Ether climbs back above about $2,096 (today's average price) and stays there for an hour with lots of trading, or if it dips to about $2,030-2,050 and bounces strongly, so a safety exit just under $2,028 still lets you win at least $1.50 for each $1 you risk.
summary: SKIP. Bull's final plan (2068 / stop 2047 / T1 2096 / T2 2113) has a properly sized stop (about 1.05x 1h ATR) but only 1.33:1 to the first real target (session VWAP), below the 1.5:1 rule, and it is a counter-trend scalp into bearish structure on 5m/15m/1h with volume dried up to 0.07-0.22x. The 13:30Z flush Bull calls capitulation coincides with the 13:30Z US October CPI release, so it reads better as a macro shock than a clean liquidation washout.
reasoning:
Fresh pull at 14:03Z: price 2068.93 (snapshot 2069.31, -0.02%), 24h low still 2028.32, session VWAP 2095.88, 1h EMA21 2109.14, 1h ATR 19.96, 1h RSI 27.8, 1h MACD histogram -3.78 (prev -3.08, still expanding), 15m histogram -2.14 (prev -1.77, also worsening), 5m histogram improving (-2.44 vs -2.79). Volume vs 20-bar average: 5m 0.22x, 15m 0.12x, 1h 0.07x. Order-book bid/ask is back to 0.63, confirming that this metric is noise. Bull's 2068 entry is reachable.

The decisive failure is the reward-to-risk rule. From 2068 with a 2047 stop (risk 21), T1 at 2096 pays 28 = 1.33:1. VWAP is the first real level and a likely seller zone, so it cannot be skipped as a target. Bull's 1.7:1 blended figure depends on T2 2113, which sits inside the 1h EMA21/SMA20 cluster (2109-2114) that a low-volume bounce must break. The stop itself is acceptable (just over 1x 1h ATR, below the 2061 micro-base).

Event check: US October CPI was released at 8:30 ET (13:30Z) today, the exact 5m candle of the 2109 to 2028 flush. Neither side identified this. It is now behind us, so it is not inside the window; the remaining items (Cisco earnings after the US close, an unconfirmed Fed Logan speech, US Veterans Day bond-market holiday tomorrow) are minor, though liquidity may thin. Bear's ETF figures check out (Mitrade: -139.7, -85.3, +53, -99.9 = -271.9M), but the 23-day streak is not in that article. Scores are close (Bull 26, Bear 27), far from the 3-point margin TAKE requires.
